summary: Full Stripe Service Payments (Pagos de Servicios) integration validated end-to-end. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed — catalog returns the 6 expected services (cert_bancario_eur €25, cert_bancario_usd $27, gestion_documental eur/usd €50/$55, abono_special45_eur €1800, abono_btc_eur €4850), checkout returns a real Stripe cs_test_ session_id + checkout.stripe.com URL and creates a payment_transactions doc (status=initiated / payment_status=pending), invalid lookup_key → 400, no-auth → 401/403, webhook with bad signature → 400, admin listing returns transactions+counts+total_paid_eur_cents+catalog, user→admin endpoint → 403, admin add-service creates and duplicates → 409, admin refund on non-paid → 400, regression bank-withdrawal & special45 config endpoints still 200. E2E CRÍTICO: With Playwright, opened real Stripe checkout for cs_test_a1eaEl…, filled email/card 4242 4242 4242 4242/12-34/123/name/manual address 123 Main St, New York, 10001, UNCHECKED the 'Save my information for faster checkout' (Link) box (crucial — otherwise phone number becomes required and blocks submit), clicked Pay → redirected to /payment/success?session_id=..., backend status endpoint immediately reported {'status':'completed','payment_status':'paid'} (Stripe fallback in payment_status route works, does not depend on webhook in preview), in-app notification 'Pago confirmado' created for the user, admin POST /api/admin/service-payments/{sid}/refund on the paid session returned 200 ok. Frontend user /payment/success shows payment-confirmed testid, /payment/cancel shows payment-cancel-page testid, /admin/service-payments lists 5 transactions incl. our paid one with 'Reembolsar' button visible, filter tabs (Todas/Pending/Paid/Failed/Expired/Refunded), Nuevo servicio button, header 'Cobrado: €25.00 · 1 pagos confirmados · 7 servicios en catálogo'.
action_items: (Info, no fix required) There is no admin endpoint to DELETE a service from the catalog. A test service 'Test Servicio QA' / lookup_key 'test_qa_eur' (€10.00) was created during the duplicate test and remains active in the Stripe catalog. It shows on the user page /pagos-servicios. Consider (a) adding an admin archive/deactivate endpoint or (b) manually archiving via Stripe dashboard.

(Cosmetic) Older pending sessions from previous main-agent runs (cs_test_a12IucWu…, cs_test_a1zGbBfh… and 2 more) remain as 'Pending' rows in the admin table. They will auto-expire on Stripe side; can be ignored.
critical_code_review_comments: service_payments.py stripe_webhook: 'charge.refunded' updates the row via stripe_payment_intent_id, but the refund UI shows the status remains 'paid' until webhook arrives — in preview environment the webhook may never be delivered, so the admin UI won't reflect 'refunded' automatically. Consider (a) a manual poll/fallback similar to payment_status that consults Stripe for latest refund state, or (b) mark the tx as 'refund_pending' immediately on POST /refund so admins see a visible state change.

service_payments.py _list_catalog iterates ALL active Stripe prices on every /catalog and /admin/service-payments call (auto_paging_iter, limit=100). Fine at 6 items but at scale this is O(N) round-trips to Stripe per request; recommend a short in-memory cache (30–60s TTL) keyed by 'catalog'.

service_payments.py checkout does not filter services by managed_by='emergent' — a user could theoretically checkout any active Stripe price by lookup_key even if it's not managed. Recommend re-fetching product and verifying prod.metadata.managed_by == 'emergent' before creating the session.

service_payments.py admin_add_service creates the Stripe product/price but does NOT wrap in try/except — if Price.create fails after Product.create, an orphaned product is left in Stripe. Add cleanup or use a single idempotent helper.

payment_status endpoint has no auth requirement — anyone with a session_id can query status. Given session_ids are long random strings this is low risk (mirrors Stripe's own model), but consider adding get_current_user + owner check for defense in depth.

ServicePaymentsPage.jsx pay() sets window.location.origin as origin_url; if the user is behind a preview URL that changes, the success/cancel redirect could break. Not a bug now but worth documenting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Cloudflare blocks urllib requests; use page.request.post + inject localStorage token+user before goto to bypass. Stripe checkout REQUIRES unchecking the 'Save my information for faster checkout' (Link) checkbox before submit — otherwise 'Required' shows on the phone number field and Pay is blocked. Use 'Enter address manually' link to expose #billingAddressLine1/#billingLocality/#billingPostalCode. Test card: 4242 4242 4242 4242 / 12 34 / 123. Backend has a fallback in GET /api/payments/status/{sid} that queries Stripe directly, so paid status is available immediately without waiting for webhook. Admin 2FA is OFF by default — direct token login works for info@paylionsbit.es/Juan1949. (with dot).
